200.description:
stream=false: application/json, the final OpenAIResponse (status completed or failed). Whitespace may precede the JSON: a newline is written after 15 s without output as a keepalive while the generation runs.

stream=true: text/event-stream of OpenAIResponseStreamEvent. Each event is `event: <type>` then `data: <json>` (no `id:` line, the stream cannot be resumed). Every payload starts with `type` (= event name) and `sequence_number` (0, 1, 2...). Order: response.created, response.in_progress, then when text is generated response.output_item.added, response.content_part.added, response.output_text.delta (repeated), response.output_text.done, response.content_part.done, response.output_item.done; and exactly one terminal event, response.completed or response.failed (error.code/message), after which the stream closes. `:keepalive` comment lines are sent after 15 s without output and must be ignored. Reasoning, tool calls and web search progress are not exposed.

200.description:
Flux Server-Sent Events. Le schema `ChatStreamEvent` decrit le JSON de chaque `data:` :
union discriminee sur `type`.

Format d'un evenement :
```
id: <entier incremental, propre au stream>
event: <type>
data: <JSON ChatStreamEvent, dont "type" == nom de l'evenement>
```
- `id` sert a la reprise : `GET /chats/{chatId}/stream` avec l'en-tete `Last-Event-ID`
  (ou `?last_event_id=`) rejoue les evenements d'id superieur puis continue en direct.
- Une ligne de commentaire `: keepalive` est envoyee apres 15 s sans evenement ; elle ne porte pas de donnees.
- Le statut HTTP reste 200 une fois le flux ouvert : les erreurs arrivent sous forme d'evenement `error`.

Evenements emis par le backend :
- `stream.open` : premier evenement, generation acceptee (`chat_id`, `first_response_timeout_ms`).
- `response.created` : message utilisateur enregistre (`chat_id`, `user_message_id`, `chat`).
- `chat.title` : titre genere (peut arriver a tout moment avant la fin).
- `tool-transcribeAudio.status` : progression de l'outil de transcription.
- `completed` (terminal) : generation terminee et persistee (`chat_id`, `message`).
- `error` (terminal) : `code` stable, `message`, `retryable`, `origin` (`backend` / `upstream`)...
- `cancelled` (terminal) : generation annulee par l'utilisateur.

Evenements relayes du fournisseur (filtres sur une liste blanche, champs inconnus retires) :
`response.output_text.delta|done`, `response.content_part.added|done`,
`response.output_item.added|done` (item `ChatStreamOutputItem`, discrimine sur `item.type`),
`response.function_call_arguments.delta|done`, `response.reasoning_summary_text.delta`,
`response.web_search_call.in_progress|searching|completed`,
`response.mcp_call.in_progress|completed|failed`, `response.mcp_call_arguments.done`,
`response.completed` et `response.failed` (non terminaux : attendre `completed` ou `error`).

Le flux se termine apres un evenement terminal (`completed`, `error` ou `cancelled`).
Les types inconnus doivent etre ignores par le client (ajouts compatibles).

ChatToolCallDto.description: Client tool call waiting for its result.

name.description: One of list_directory, read_file, search_files, edit_file, write_file, run_command.

arguments.description: Arguments of the call (JSON object following the tool schema).

OpenAIResponseCreateRequest.description: OpenAI Responses API request. Only the fields below are used; any other parameter (instructions, temperature, max_output_tokens, custom tools, ...) is accepted and ignored.

model.description: Model id, as listed by GET /v1/models (the model name is also accepted).

input.description: Either a string (the user message) or a list of input messages. Only the last message with role user is sent: the conversation history is kept server-side.

previous_response_id.description: Id of a previous response (resp_...) to continue its conversation; without it a new chat is created. Unknown, foreign or PIN-locked conversations return 404.

stream.description: true for a text/event-stream of OpenAIResponseStreamEvent, false (default) for a single OpenAIResponse JSON.

tools.description: Tools. A tool whose type starts with web_search enables web search; other tools are ignored.

type.description: Item type; defaults to message.

role.description: Message role; only user messages are used.

content.description: Either a string or a list of content parts. The text of input_text/text parts is joined with blank lines; other parts (images, files) are ignored.

OpenAIResponseInputText.description: Text content part of an input message.

type.description: Part type.

OpenAIResponseTool.description: Requested tool; only web_search* types have an effect.

type.description: Tool type, e.g. web_search or web_search_preview.

id.description: Response id (resp_ + chat id); pass it as previous_response_id to continue the conversation.

output.description: Output items: empty while in progress or on failure, else the assistant message.

error.description: Error when status is failed; null otherwise (always written).

store.description: Always true: the conversation is stored as a chat.

tools.description: Always empty: tools are not echoed.

usage.description: Token usage when status is completed; null otherwise (always written).

code.description: Error code: the chat stream error code, cancelled, or server_error.

type.description: Item type.

content.description: Content parts: empty while in progress, else one output_text part.

OpenAIResponseOutputText.description: Text content part of the assistant message.

type.description: Part type.

OpenAIResponseUsage.description: Token usage of a completed response.

OpenAIResponseCompletedEvent.description: Terminal event: the response completed. The stream ends after it.

type.description: Event discriminator, equal to the SSE event name.

sequence_number.description: Position of the event in the stream, starting at 0.

response.description: The final response (status completed, output, usage).

OpenAIResponseContentPartAddedEvent.description: The output_text content part of the message started.

type.description: Event discriminator, equal to the SSE event name.

sequence_number.description: Position of the event in the stream, starting at 0.

output_index.description: Index of the item in output (always 0).

content_index.description: Index of the part in the item content (always 0).

OpenAIResponseContentPartDoneEvent.description: The output_text content part is complete.

type.description: Event discriminator, equal to the SSE event name.

sequence_number.description: Position of the event in the stream, starting at 0.

output_index.description: Index of the item in output (always 0).

content_index.description: Index of the part in the item content (always 0).

part.description: The part, with the full text.

type.description: Event discriminator, equal to the SSE event name.

sequence_number.description: Position of the event in the stream, starting at 0.

response.description: The response, status in_progress, empty output.

type.description: Event discriminator, equal to the SSE event name.

sequence_number.description: Position of the event in the stream, starting at 0.

type.description: Event discriminator, equal to the SSE event name.

sequence_number.description: Position of the event in the stream, starting at 0.

response.description: The response, status in_progress, empty output.

OpenAIResponseOutputItemAddedEvent.description: The assistant message item started (status in_progress, no content yet).

type.description: Event discriminator, equal to the SSE event name.

sequence_number.description: Position of the event in the stream, starting at 0.

output_index.description: Index of the item in output (always 0).

item.description: The message item, status in_progress, empty content.

OpenAIResponseOutputItemDoneEvent.description: The assistant message item is complete.

type.description: Event discriminator, equal to the SSE event name.

sequence_number.description: Position of the event in the stream, starting at 0.

output_index.description: Index of the item in output (always 0).

item.description: The message item, status completed, with its text.

OpenAIResponseOutputTextDeltaEvent.description: A chunk of assistant text to append.

type.description: Event discriminator, equal to the SSE event name.

sequence_number.description: Position of the event in the stream, starting at 0.

output_index.description: Index of the item in output (always 0).

content_index.description: Index of the part in the item content (always 0).

logprobs.description: Always empty: log probabilities are not exposed.

type.description: Event discriminator, equal to the SSE event name.

sequence_number.description: Position of the event in the stream, starting at 0.

output_index.description: Index of the item in output (always 0).

content_index.description: Index of the part in the item content (always 0).

OpenAIResponseStreamEvent.description: Event of the /v1/responses SSE stream, discriminated by type (= SSE event name).

callId.description: callId of the pending tool call this result answers.
